name: Associações
tagline: Escreva a palavra que todos vão escrever e ganhe a cada coincidência.
description: Jogue Associações grátis: de 2 a 8 veem uma palavra e escrevem o que os outros vão escrever, com pontos a cada coincidência. Contra bots, num aparelho ou online.
about: Associations is a quick party game of thinking alike, for 2 to 8 players. Each round shows a word, like Beach or Winter, and everyone writes the first word they think the others will write.

You score a point for every other player who wrote the same word as you: sand and sand match, and so do Ice cream and ice-cream, since case, spaces and accents don't count. Nobody wins by being clever; you win by being in tune.
Play 5 or 8 rounds; the most points win, and a tie is shared. Online, every answer is held on our server until everyone has written, so nobody can copy.
howToPlay: Choose the language of the words and 5 or 8 rounds, then Play vs bots, Play on this device, or create a room.
Read the word, then write the one you think everyone else will write, and press Send.
Your word stays hidden until everyone has written; then all are shown.
You get a point for each other player who wrote the same word.
After the last round, the most points win.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap the field, type your word, then Send.
Mouse and keyboard: type your word and press Enter.
Letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens, up to 24.
tips: Go for the obvious: the most common word is usually the best.
Watch what the others wrote before: some players think alike.
One word is safer than two.
Bots know the most common associations; hard ones go straight for them.

faq.question: Is it free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Do spelling and capitals matter?
faq.answer: Capitals, spaces, hyphens and accents on Latin letters don't. Spelling does: write the word as the others would.

faq.question: Which languages are there?
faq.answer: English and Bulgarian words for now; more languages are coming.

faq.question: Can others see my word first?
faq.answer: No. Online, every answer is held on our server until everyone has written.
